messages:
maria-peopleops: Heads-up: new remote contractor (Mumbai) starts Mon 2025-06-09. Not a US resident. Need I-9 decision, BG intake, benefits note, laptop courier + IST-friendly orientation. @sam-hiring @anya-hr

sam-hiring: Hiring manager. Student contractor for 10 weeks. No SSN. Wants limited code access on day 1 to shadow PRs.

anya-hr: Policy reminder: non-US hires do not complete US I-9. Options: local payroll (if we have entity) or contractor engagement (collect W-8BEN or local tax/KYC). Benefits ineligible unless local program.

maria-peopleops: Ok we'll onboard as contractor for now. @onboard-bot please send BG consent and start vendor flow; vendor supports India but needs phone + govt ID. Also need laptop ETA and buddy in IST.

onboard-bot: Consent link sent to candidate (2025-06-02T09:03Z). Vendor: Checkr Intl. Candidate asked to provide local phone and ID scan.

infra-team: We can ship via DHL Express to Mumbai. ETA 3-5 business days after label. Image will have dev image; VPN & prod certs disabled until BG clear. Provide shipping address.

jade-buddy: I can be buddy. Propose Wed/Thu 11:00-11:30 IST for first-week syncs. I'll record a 12-min walkthrough they can watch beforehand.

anya-hr: India BG usually ~7-10 business days if verifications needed. Recommend gating production credentials until BG status == cleared. Provide limited dev account and sanitized data for day 1 tasks.

sam-hiring: Agreed. Please flag the onboarding ticket to block secrets/prod access until BG cleared and ensure contractor agreement + invoice cadence are prepared.

maria-peopleops: Action list: (1) @onboard-bot: consent & BG kickoff (done), (2) @infra-team: create shipping label once address confirmed and lock VPN/prod certs until cleared, (3) @jade-buddy: buddy + prerecord, (4) @anya-hr: send contractor tax/KYC + agreement. I'll post APAC onboarding FAQ link and add note to reassess payroll vs contractor if engagement extends. :thumbsup:
